metadata.description: Azure region for all resources
Kosten/Zuordnung: Umgebung (prod/test/dev)
Traceability: BSSE Deploy-Ref (z.B. Git Tag oder Commit SHA)
Name of the Vaultwarden Container App
Container image to use for Vaultwarden (pin a version for reproducible deployments)
CPU cores for the container
Memory in GiB for the container (CPU:RAM ratio must be 1:2)
Allow insecure HTTP traffic (recommended: false for production)
Enable Azure Monitor diagnostic settings for Key Vault and PostgreSQL Flexible Server (Log Analytics).
Optional forceUpdateTag for the bootstrap deploymentScript. Change this value to force a controlled rerun without changing app settings.
Public URL of your Vaultwarden instance. MUST include https:// (example: https://sub.domain.tld)

Vaultwarden ADMIN_TOKEN als App-ENV setzen. Default true fuer Erstdeployment/Bootstrap/Tests. Fuer den produktiven Steady State nach erfolgreichem Setup auf false setzen, damit ADMIN_TOKEN nicht mehr an die App durchgereicht wird. Achtung: Falls admin_token bereits in /data/config.json persistiert wurde, dort ebenfalls entfernen, sonst bleibt das Admin-Panel aktiv.
Vaultwarden ENV: INVITATION_ORG_NAME. Organization name shown in invitation mails.
Vaultwarden ENV: SIGNUPS_DOMAINS_WHITELIST. Comma-separated email domains allowed to self-register.
Vaultwarden ENV: ORG_CREATION_USERS. Optional comma-separated user emails allowed to create organizations. Empty = all users.

Explizite Root-Domain für Mailrouting und Default-Absender (z. B. example.com). Verwende diesen Parameter für Direct Send ohne expliziten smtpHost, für ACS Foundation ohne explizites acsDomainName und für den automatischen Default-Absender, wenn smtpFrom leer bleibt. Keine Ableitung mehr aus domainUrl.

Wenn true, nutzt Vaultwarden SMTP Submission mit Auth (empfohlener Produktiv-Default). Wenn false, wird Direct Send ohne Auth verwendet. Wichtig für Vaultwarden: In diesem Modus werden SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD und SMTP_AUTH_MECHANISM nicht an die App durchgereicht; bereits im Vaultwarden-Adminbereich gespeicherte SMTP-Auth-Werte in /data/config.json müssen bei einem Moduswechsel ggf. separat bereinigt werden.
SMTP FROM address (z. B. vaultwarden@domain.tld). Für Produktion explizit setzen.
Anzeigename im From-Header.
Vaultwarden ENV: HELO_NAME. Empty = derive host name from DOMAIN / domainUrl.

Optionaler SMTP Host Override. Leer = SMTP Auth: smtp.office365.com; Direct Send: MX-Lookup ausschließlich auf mailRootDomain. Für den aktuellen Direct-Send-Pfad setzt das Template in der App SMTP_PORT=25 und SMTP_SECURITY=starttls und lässt SMTP_USERNAME / SMTP_PASSWORD / SMTP_AUTH_MECHANISM weg.
SMTP port (M365 default: 587)
SMTP security (starttls / force_tls / off)
SMTP username (often same as smtpFrom)
SMTP password
Optional (nur SMTP Auth): SMTP Auth Mechanism. Mögliche Werte u.a.: Plain, Login, Xoauth2 (auch kommasepariert).
Enable Vaultwarden SSO (OIDC) for Web Vault login (requires Vaultwarden >= 1.35).
If true, only SSO login is allowed (no email/password). Use with care.
OIDC authority/issuer base URL. For Entra ID use https://login.microsoftonline.com/<TENANT_ID>/v2.0 and do not append /.well-known/openid-configuration.
OIDC Client ID / Application (client) ID.
OIDC Client Secret / App secret value.
OIDC scopes passed to Vaultwarden. For Entra ID the default openid profile email offline_access User.Read is recommended.
Enable mobile push notifications (requires Bitwarden push relay credentials).
Bitwarden push installation id (from https://bitwarden.com/host/). Treated as secret and stored in Key Vault.
Bitwarden push installation key (from https://bitwarden.com/host/). Treated as secret and stored in Key Vault.
Use Bitwarden EU push relay / identity endpoints. Select this only when the Installation ID / Key were requested for the EU region.

Optional: deploy Azure Communication Services foundation resources (Email Service, Email Domain resource, Communication Service) together with the core stack. Domain verification, domain linking and SMTP username activation remain manual post-deploy steps.
ACS data location for Email Service and Communication Service, e.g. Germany, Europe or UnitedStates. Email Service and Communication Service must use the same geography.
Custom domain to prepare in ACS Email, e.g. example.com. Leer = verwende mailRootDomain. Es gibt keine automatische Ableitung mehr aus domainUrl.
Storage account SKU for Azure Files
Enable Azure Backup for the Azure File Share used by Vaultwarden (/data).
Time of day (HH:MM) when backup should run. MM must be 00 or 30.
Windows timezone name for the backup schedule, e.g. UTC, W. Europe Standard Time.
Number of days to retain daily Azure Files backups.
Days of week used for weekly retention points.
Number of weeks to retain weekly Azure Files backups.
PostgreSQL SKU name
PostgreSQL storage size in GB
Point-in-time restore retention in Tagen für PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
Allow Azure services to access PostgreSQL (0.0.0.0 firewall rule). Recommended: true for Container Apps without VNet/NAT.
Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server administrator login. Required for server creation and initial bootstrap only; not used by the Vaultwarden app itself.
Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server administrator password. Required for server creation and initial bootstrap only; not stored in Key Vault and not used as Vaultwarden app credential.

resources.name: [format('{0}-ensure-kv-secrets', parameters('appName'))]

properties.scriptContent:
set -euo pipefail

echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ensuring Key Vault secrets exist in $KEYVAULT_NAME ..."

# Ensure we are authenticated (deploymentScripts should use the assigned managed identity, but harden against missing session)
if ! az account show 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] az account not available - logging in with managed identity"
  if [ -n "${UAMI_CLIENT_ID:-}" ]; then
    az login --identity --client-id "$UAMI_CLIENT_ID" 1>/dev/null
  else
    az login --identity 1>/dev/null
  fi
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Input validation
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "${SMTP_USE_AUTH:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -z "${SMTP_USERNAME_INPUT:-}" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: smtpUseAuth=true requires smtpUsername."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -z "${SMTP_PASSWORD_VALUE:-}" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: smtpUseAuth=true requires smtpPassword."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [ -z "${SMTP_FROM_INPUT:-}" ] && [ -z "${MAIL_ROOT_DOMAIN:-}" ]; then
  echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: Either smtpFrom or mailRootDomain must be set."
  echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] Auto-generating SMTP_FROM from domainUrl is intentionally no longer supported."
  exit 1
fi

if [ "${SMTP_USE_AUTH:-false}" != "true" ] && [ -z "${SMTP_HOST_INPUT:-}" ] && [ -z "${MAIL_ROOT_DOMAIN:-}" ]; then
  echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: Direct Send without explicit smtpHost requires mailRootDomain."
  exit 1
fi

# domainUrl validation
case "${DOMAIN_URL:-}" in
  https://*)
    ;;
  *)
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: domainUrl must start with https:// (got: '${DOMAIN_URL:-}')."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if [ "${SSO_ENABLED:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -z "${SSO_AUTHORITY_INPUT:-}" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: ssoEnabled=true requires ssoAuthority."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -z "${SSO_CLIENT_ID_INPUT:-}" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: ssoEnabled=true requires ssoClientId."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -z "${SSO_CLIENT_SECRET_VALUE:-}" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: ssoEnabled=true requires ssoClientSecret."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [ "${PUSH_ENABLED:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -z "${PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_VALUE:-}" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: pushEnabled=true requires pushInstallationId."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -z "${PUSH_INSTALLATION_KEY_VALUE:-}" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: pushEnabled=true requires pushInstallationKey."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

WAIT_RETRIES="${WAIT_RETRIES:-60}"
WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS="${WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS:-10}"
export WAIT_RETRIES WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS

PG_CLI_BASE=(az postgres flexible-server execute -g "$RESOURCE_GROUP_NAME" -n "$POSTGRES_SERVER_NAME" -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" -p "$DB_ADMIN_PASSWORD")

echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] waiting for Key Vault permissions..."
for i in $(seq 1 "$WAIT_RETRIES"); do
  if az keyvault secret list --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --maxresults 1 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] Key Vault access OK"
    break
  fi
  echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] Key Vault access not ready yet ($i/$WAIT_RETRIES), sleeping ${WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS}s..."
  sleep "$WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS"
  if [ "$i" -eq "$WAIT_RETRIES" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: Key Vault permissions not ready after $((WAIT_RETRIES*WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS))s"
    exit 1
  fi
done

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for PostgreSQL to accept connections
# ------------------------------------------------------------
echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] waiting for PostgreSQL connectivity..."
for i in $(seq 1 "$WAIT_RETRIES"); do
  if "${PG_CLI_BASE[@]}" -d postgres -q "SELECT 1" 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] PostgreSQL reachable"
    break
  fi
  echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] PostgreSQL not ready yet ($i/$WAIT_RETRIES), sleeping ${WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS}s..."
  sleep "$WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS"
  if [ "$i" -eq "$WAIT_RETRIES" ]; then
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: PostgreSQL not reachable after $((WAIT_RETRIES*WAIT_SLEEP_SECONDS))s"
    exit 1
  fi
done

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Secrets in Key Vault
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# --- ADMIN_TOKEN ---
if az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$ADMIN_TOKEN_SECRET" 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "ADMIN_TOKEN secret already exists."
else
  echo "Creating ADMIN_TOKEN secret..."
  ADMIN_TOKEN=$(python3 - << 'PY'
import secrets, base64
print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(48)).decode('utf-8').rstrip('='))
PY
)
  az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$ADMIN_TOKEN_SECRET" --value "$ADMIN_TOKEN" 1>/dev/null
  echo "ADMIN_TOKEN secret created."
fi

# --- SMTP password ---
if [ "${SMTP_USE_AUTH:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  CURRENT_SMTP_PASSWORD=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$SMTP_PASSWORD_SECRET" --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -z "$CURRENT_SMTP_PASSWORD" ] || [ "$CURRENT_SMTP_PASSWORD" != "$SMTP_PASSWORD_VALUE" ]; then
    echo "Setting SMTP password secret..."
    az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$SMTP_PASSWORD_SECRET" --value "$SMTP_PASSWORD_VALUE" 1>/dev/null
    echo "SMTP password secret set."
  else
    echo "SMTP password secret already up to date."
  fi
else
  echo "SMTP auth disabled (Direct Send). Skipping SMTP password secret."
fi

# --- SSO client secret (OIDC) ---
if [ "${SSO_ENABLED:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  CURRENT_SSO_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$SSO_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRET" --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -z "$CURRENT_SSO_SECRET" ] || [ "$CURRENT_SSO_SECRET" != "$SSO_CLIENT_SECRET_VALUE" ]; then
    echo "Setting SSO client secret..."
    az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$SSO_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRET" --value "$SSO_CLIENT_SECRET_VALUE" 1>/dev/null
    echo "SSO client secret set."
  else
    echo "SSO client secret already up to date."
  fi
else
  echo "SSO disabled. Skipping SSO client secret."
fi

# --- Push installation id / key (Bitwarden push relay) ---
if [ "${PUSH_ENABLED:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  CURRENT_PUSH_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_SECRET" --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -z "$CURRENT_PUSH_ID" ] || [ "$CURRENT_PUSH_ID" != "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_VALUE" ]; then
    echo "Setting Push installation id..."
    az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_SECRET" --value "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_ID_VALUE" 1>/dev/null
    echo "Push installation id set."
  else
    echo "Push installation id already up to date."
  fi
else
  echo "Push notifications disabled. Skipping Push installation id."
fi

# --- Push installation key (Bitwarden push relay) ---
if [ "${PUSH_ENABLED:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  CURRENT_PUSH_KEY=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_KEY_SECRET" --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -z "$CURRENT_PUSH_KEY" ] || [ "$CURRENT_PUSH_KEY" != "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_KEY_VALUE" ]; then
    echo "Setting Push installation key..."
    az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_KEY_SECRET" --value "$PUSH_INSTALLATION_KEY_VALUE" 1>/dev/null
    echo "Push installation key set."
  else
    echo "Push installation key already up to date."
  fi
else
  echo "Push notifications disabled. Skipping Push installation key."
fi

# --- App DB password (least-privilege user for Vaultwarden) ---
if az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DB_APP_PASSWORD_SECRET" 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "App DB password secret already exists."
  DB_APP_PASSWORD=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DB_APP_PASSWORD_SECRET" --query value -o tsv)
else
  echo "Creating App DB password secret..."
  DB_APP_PASSWORD=$(python3 - << 'PY'
import secrets
print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))
PY
)
  az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DB_APP_PASSWORD_SECRET" --value "$DB_APP_PASSWORD" 1>/dev/null
  echo "App DB password secret created."
fi

export DB_APP_PASSWORD="$DB_APP_PASSWORD"
SQL_TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
export SQL_TMP_DIR
trap 'rm -rf "$SQL_TMP_DIR"' EXIT

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Provision least-privilege role & grants (idempotent)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
echo "Provisioning Postgres role '$DB_APP_USER' and database privileges (idempotent) ..."
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path

def qident(s: str) -> str:
    return '"' + s.replace('"', '""') + '"'

def qlit(s: str) -> str:
    return "'" + s.replace("'", "''") + "'"

app_user = os.environ['DB_APP_USER']
app_pw = os.environ['DB_APP_PASSWORD']
db_name = os.environ['POSTGRES_DBNAME']
out_dir = Path(os.environ['SQL_TMP_DIR'])

admin_sql = f'''DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = {qlit(app_user)}) THEN
    CREATE ROLE {qident(app_user)} LOGIN PASSWORD {qlit(app_pw)};
  END IF;
END
$$;

ALTER ROLE {qident(app_user)} WITH LOGIN PASSWORD {qlit(app_pw)} NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT;
GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE {qident(db_name)} TO {qident(app_user)};
'''

db_sql = f'GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO {qident(app_user)};\n'

(out_dir / 'bootstrap-admin.sql').write_text(admin_sql)
(out_dir / 'bootstrap-db.sql').write_text(db_sql)
PY

"${PG_CLI_BASE[@]}" -d postgres -f "$SQL_TMP_DIR/bootstrap-admin.sql" 1>/dev/null
"${PG_CLI_BASE[@]}" -d "$POSTGRES_DBNAME" -f "$SQL_TMP_DIR/bootstrap-db.sql" 1>/dev/null
echo "Postgres provisioning done."

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DATABASE_URL (PostgreSQL connection string for Vaultwarden)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ENCODED_APP_PASSWORD=$(python3 - << 'PY'
import os, urllib.parse
print(urllib.parse.quote(os.environ.get("DB_APP_PASSWORD",""), safe=""))
PY
)

DATABASE_URL="postgresql://${DB_APP_USER}:${ENCODED_APP_PASSWORD}@${POSTGRES_FQDN}:${POSTGRES_PORT}/${POSTGRES_DBNAME}?sslmode=${TLS_SSLMODE}"

if az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DATABASE_URL_SECRET" 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
  CURRENT_DBURL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DATABASE_URL_SECRET" --query value -o tsv || echo "")
  if echo "$CURRENT_DBURL" | grep -qiE '^postgres(ql)?://'; then
    if echo "$CURRENT_DBURL" | grep -q "://${DB_ADMIN_USER}:"; then
      echo "DATABASE_URL currently uses admin user; updating to app user..."
      az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DATABASE_URL_SECRET" --value "$DATABASE_URL" 1>/dev/null
      echo "DATABASE_URL secret updated."
    else
      echo "DATABASE_URL secret already exists and looks valid."
    fi
  else
    echo "DATABASE_URL secret exists but looks invalid; updating to PostgreSQL URL..."
    az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DATABASE_URL_SECRET" --value "$DATABASE_URL" 1>/dev/null
    echo "DATABASE_URL secret updated."
  fi
else
  echo "Creating DATABASE_URL secret..."
  az keyvault secret set --vault-name "$KEYVAULT_NAME" --name "$DATABASE_URL_SECRET" --value "$DATABASE_URL" 1>/dev/null
  echo "DATABASE_URL secret created."
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SMTP host resolution (Direct Send without auth)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Default behavior:
# - SMTP Auth: smtp.office365.com (unless SMTP_HOST_INPUT is set)
# - Direct Send: resolve MX of MAIL_ROOT_DOMAIN (unless SMTP_HOST_INPUT is set)

MX_HOST=""
if [ "${SMTP_USE_AUTH:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -n "${SMTP_HOST_INPUT:-}" ]; then
    MX_HOST="${SMTP_HOST_INPUT}"
  else
    MX_HOST="smtp.office365.com"
  fi
else
  if [ -n "${SMTP_HOST_INPUT:-}" ]; then
    MX_HOST="${SMTP_HOST_INPUT}"
  else
    BASE_DOMAIN="$(printf '%s' "${MAIL_ROOT_DOMAIN:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | xargs)"
    if [ -z "${BASE_DOMAIN}" ]; then
      echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: Direct Send without explicit smtpHost requires mailRootDomain."
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] Resolving MX for ${BASE_DOMAIN} ..."

    if command -v dig 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
      MX_HOST=$(dig +short MX "${BASE_DOMAIN}" | python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
best=None
for line in sys.stdin:
    line=line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    parts=line.split()
    if len(parts) < 2:
        continue
    try:
        pref=int(parts[0])
    except Exception:
        continue
    host=parts[1].rstrip('.')
    if best is None or pref < best[0]:
        best=(pref,host)
if best:
    print(best[1])
PY
)
    elif command -v nslookup 1>/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
      MX_HOST=$(nslookup -type=mx "${BASE_DOMAIN}" 2>/dev/null | python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, re
best=None
pat=re.compile(r'preference\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*mail exchanger\s*=\s*(\S+)')
for line in sys.stdin:
    m=pat.search(line)
    if not m:
        continue
    pref=int(m.group(1))
    host=m.group(2).rstrip('.')
    if best is None or pref < best[0]:
        best=(pref,host)
if best:
    print(best[1])
PY
)
    else
      echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: Neither dig nor nslookup is available for Direct Send MX lookup."
      echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] Provide smtpHost explicitly when smtpUseAuth=false."
      exit 1
    fi

    if [ -z "${MX_HOST}" ]; then
      echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] ERROR: MX lookup returned empty for ${BASE_DOMAIN}. Provide smtpHost override (parameter 'smtpHost') for Direct Send."
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
fi
echo "[vault-ensure-kv-secrets] SMTP host resolved: ${MX_HOST}"

cat > "$AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH" <<JSON
{
  "status": "ok",
  "smtp_host": "${MX_HOST}"
}
JSON

echo "Done."
